name: Grand Theft Perth gameplay rubric
anchor: GTA V / GTA VI third-person on-foot play (Rockstar RAGE locomotion, melee and camera), on desktop and phone
scale: 0-10 per dimension; 5 = playable but clearly amateur, 7 = solid commercial indie, 8.5 = AAA-like, 10 = indistinguishable from GTA

dimensions.locomotion: Feet stay planted (no skating), gait matches ground speed, smooth idle/walk/run/sprint transitions, natural acceleration and stopping, turns pivot and lean like a person, no robotic snapping or sliding.
dimensions.responsiveness: Input to motion latency, analog stick response curve (gentle push walks, full push runs), sprint, jump, consistent camera-relative control on desktop and phone.
dimensions.camera: Third-person framing keeps the player readable and slightly left of centre, smooth follow, collision handling, no clipping, sensible FOV changes, shake used sparingly.
dimensions.combat: Punches read as punches (wind-up, extension, recovery), soft lock-on and lunge so they connect, combos, hit reactions (flinch, stagger, knock-down), enemies fighting back, damage and timing that feel fair.
dimensions.world_boundaries: Water edges, quay walls, buildings and props are solid on foot; no walking on or into water by accident; swimming and climbing out behave plausibly; no falling through the world.
dimensions.npc_behaviour: Pedestrians react believably to the player and violence (flee, cower, fight back, call police), keep personal space without teleporting or sliding, crowds look natural.
dimensions.hud_ux: HUD never hides the player or key action, scales with the viewport, legible, mobile controls sized and placed for thumbs, clear objectives.
dimensions.feedback: Audio-visual juice: hit-stop, camera kick, impact and whoosh sounds, footstep/landing cues, visible consequences.
dimensions.fun_loop: Clear things to do minute to minute, mission pacing, emergent play (police, chases, stealing vehicles), reasons to keep playing.
dimensions.stability: No errors, no stuck states, no glitches in the captured play.
